title: Derp Universe — Game Definition Schemas
description: JSON schema documentation for all game definition data files loaded by the definitions seed.

RuleRefNode.description: A reference to a named reusable SelectionRuleDef row. Embeds the referenced rule's selection tree inline at evaluation time.

id.description: ID of the SelectionRuleDef to evaluate.

label.description: Optional admin-facing label for this reference.

RichSelectionRule.description: A single leaf condition node in a RichSelection tree.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for this rule node.

scope.description: Which context object to read from (player, entity, team, location, etc.).

field.description: Dot-path field on the scope object (e.g. keeperLevel, flags.beta_tester).

aggregate.description: How to reduce multiple values (entity/team scopes).

value.description: Comparison value (number, string, boolean, or array).

RichSelectionChild.description: A single child node inside a RichSelection group — either a sub-group, a leaf rule, or a rule_ref.

RichSelection.description: A boolean condition tree used for requirements, visibility, and other eligibility checks.

op.description: Boolean operator applied to all child rules.

rules.description: Child nodes — each is a sub-group, a leaf rule, or a rule_ref.

SelectionRuleDef.description: A named, reusable RichSelection condition stored in the database and referenced by rule_ref nodes.

selection.description: The condition tree this rule encapsulates.

enabled.description: Disabled rules always return false when referenced.

SynergySelector.description: Filters which entities a SynergyRule applies to. All fields are optional; an empty object {} matches any entity.

entityTypes.description: Match entities whose entityType is in this list.

speciesIds.description: Match entities whose speciesId (entityDefinitionId) is in this list.

collections.description: Match entities whose collectionId (NftCollectionDef.id) is in this list.

traitsAny.description: Match entities that have at least one of these archetype values in any trait slot. Case-insensitive.

traitsAll.description: Match entities that have ALL of these archetype values (each in any slot). Case-insensitive.

minTraitCount.description: Minimum number of distinct non-null trait values the entity must have.

rarities.description: Match entities whose rarity is in this list (e.g. 'common', 'rare', 'legendary').

regions.description: Match entities currently stationed in one of these regionIds.

locationTypes.description: Match entities currently in a location of one of these types.

buildingTagsAny.description: Match entities at a location that has at least one of these building tags.

missionTagsAny.description: Match entities with at least one of these mission tags.

factions.description: Match entities whose traits.faction value is in this list. Case-insensitive.

SynergyContext.description: Constrains which activity contexts trigger a SynergyRule. All fields are optional; an empty object {} matches any context.

activityTypes.description: Match activities whose activityType is in this list (e.g. 'mission', 'crafting', 'outpost').

missionTypes.description: Match missions whose missionType is in this list (e.g. 'quick', 'boss', 'seasonal').

missionTagsAny.description: Match activities tagged with at least one of these mission tags.

regionIds.description: Match activities occurring in one of these regions.

seasonIds.description: Match activities occurring during one of these seasons.

requiresTeamSizeMin.description: Rule only fires when the team has at least this many entities.

requiresTeamSizeMax.description: Rule only fires when the team has at most this many entities.

SynergyEffect.description: A single effect emitted by a SynergyRule when it fires.

operation.description: How the value is applied. flat_add: absolute addition. percent_add: percentage addition (e.g. -10 = -10%). multiplier: multiplicative (compound exponent with applications). flat_seconds: absolute seconds added to duration.

value.description: Numeric value for the operation. Negative = penalty/reduction.

stat.description: Stat key for stat_modifier (e.g. ATK, DEF, SPD, FOC, VIT, LCK).

immuneTo.description: Named debuff or effect type for immunity.

SynergyRule.description: A data-driven synergy rule that awards bonuses or penalties based on entity trait combinations and activity context.

effects.description: Effects emitted when the rule fires.

stackGroup.description: Optional group name for cross-rule stacking logic.

stackMode.description: additive: each pair fires independently. unique: fires once if any pair matches. best_only: only the highest-positive-value rule in the stackGroup fires. highest_abs_only: only the highest |value| rule fires.

maxApplications.description: Max times this rule fires per resolver call.

startsAt.description: ISO datetime — rule only fires after this time.

endsAt.description: ISO datetime — rule stops firing after this time.

EffectDefOverrides.description: Safe-to-override fields on an EffectDef. Structural fields (category, valueMode, durationModel, stackingRule, targetType) are intentionally excluded. Merged on top of EffectDef defaults at apply time.

durationSec.description: Overrides the effect duration in seconds.

durationTicks.description: Overrides the effect duration in ticks.

EffectSelection.description: Describes exactly who a global power effect applies to. Stored as JSON on GlobalActivePower. Evaluated by matchesSelection() in the effect resolver.

scope.description: global: applies to all target types (default). player: applies only when resolving for a player target. entity: entity-level targets only. location: location-level targets only.

agg.description: any: applies to all instances of that scope world-wide. self: applies only to instances belonging to the player who triggered the power (triggeredByUserId).

filter.description: Optional predicate map that narrows which targets within a scope are affected. Predicates are skipped when targetContext is absent at resolution time.

rarity.description: Single rarity or list of rarities to match.

traits.description: All listed traits must be present on the target.

minLevel.description: Target level must be >= this value.

maxLevel.description: Target level must be <= this value.

UniqueLocationPower.description: A unique NFT-gated power for a location. Tick-speed powers use powerType; all other powers must provide effectDefId.

powerType.description: Used only for tick speed boost powers. Omit for all other power types.

effectDefId.description: Required for non-tick powers. References an EffectDef row.

durationMinutes.description: How long the global power stays active.

dailyLimit.description: Max triggers per UTC day. Defaults to 1.

ConsumableEffectSpec.description: Spec for a single effect emitted by a consumable item.

targetType.description: Which target the effect applies to.

effectOverrides.description: Optional overrides merged on top of the EffectDef defaults at apply time.

InjuryRecoveryReductionEffectDef.description:
EffectDef shape for the `injury_recovery_reduction` category. durationModel must be `instant`. Adjusts the target entity's injuredUntilTick — positive value shortens recovery (heals), negative value extends it (debuff/curse). The entity must be in the `injured` state when the consumable is used, otherwise a 400 error is returned.

Supported valueModes:
  - `flat_add` (default): `value` is interpreted as minutes. The tick adjustment is `value * 60` ticks, tick-rate-independent.
  - `percent_add`: `value` is a percentage (0–100, or negative). The tick adjustment is `floor(value / 100 * remainingTicks)` where remainingTicks = injuredUntilTick − currentTick.

Full recovery (newTick ≤ currentTick): entity state is immediately set to `idle` and injuredUntilTick is cleared — no need to wait for the next tick processor pass.

name.description: Display name shown in the consumable notification.

durationModel.description: Must be `instant`. No other duration model is supported for this category.

valueMode.description: flat_add: value is minutes (× 60 ticks). percent_add: value is percentage of remaining recovery ticks.

value.description: Magnitude of the adjustment. Positive = shorten recovery. Negative = extend recovery (debuff). For flat_add: minutes. For percent_add: 0–100 (or negative).

RecipeTierBlock.description: Reward block for a single crafting quality tier. Used as values in RecipeDef.tiers.

rewards.description: Outcome entries granted when this tier is rolled. Same shape as mission/lootbox rewards arrays.

clRequirement.description: Optional override for the Gaussian bell-curve center (CL sweet-spot) for this tier. When omitted the QUALITY_TIERS default center is used.

RecipeDef.description: Crafting recipe definition. Drives the two-step probabilistic outcome system: Step 1 pass/fail gate (passRate = effectiveCL / (effectiveCL + difficulty)), Step 2 Gaussian quality roll across the 6 success tiers.

timer.description: Duration and skip settings {duration, skipable, boostable, skip_cost, skip_type}

difficulty.description: Pass/fail gate difficulty. passRate = effectiveCL / (effectiveCL + difficulty). 0 = always passes (no gate). Higher values make failure more likely at low CL.

tiers.description: Per-tier reward blocks keyed by quality tier. Valid keys: failure | common | uncommon | scare | rare | epic | mythic | legendary. Each value is a RecipeTierBlock. The 'failure' tier fires when the pass/fail gate fails. The 7 success tiers are weighted by a Gaussian bell curve centered at CL 15/45/75/105/135/165/195. Optional top-level 'sigma' (number, default 22) narrows or widens the bell curve for this recipe.

sigma.description: Optional Gaussian sigma override (default 22). Lower = narrower spread, higher = wider.

multicraft.description: Multicraft config enabling batch crafting. null = single craft only.

mode.description: 'tiers' = only specific quantities allowed; 'free' = any quantity up to max

timer.description: 'flat' = fixed duration regardless of quantity; 'linear' = duration × quantity. Default: flat

requirements.description: RichSelection tree — conditions the player must satisfy to start crafting

visibilityRequirements.description: RichSelection tree — conditions that must be met for the recipe to appear in the UI

effects.description: Effects applied to entities on completion

data.description: Extra freeform data. { tier: 1|2|3 } sets the workshop tier requirement.

activeModalDefId.description: ModalDef.id shown while crafting is in-progress

readyModalDefId.description: ModalDef.id shown when crafting is ready to collect

TelemetryDef.description: Data-driven aggregate event counter definition. Admins author these to track MISSION_START/SUCCESS/FAIL events with optional RichSelection filters.

startDate.description: Lower date bound (inclusive); null = no bound

endDate.description: Upper date bound (inclusive); null = no bound

TelemetrySubEventSpec.description: One counter within a TelemetryDef — bound to an event type and optional RichSelection filter.

filter.description: Optional RichSelection filter; null = match all events of eventType

TelemetryCountDto.description: Counter value for one sub-event within a TelemetryDef.

ScreenCompositionDefinition.description: A versioned screen composition definition. Stored in the GameDefinition table with type=screen_composition.

screenKey.description: Stable screen identifier used by the app router, e.g. home_screen.

componentKey.description: Must match a registered client component key.

MissionDef_requirements_fields.description: MissionDef has two separate RichSelection gate fields that the game engine evaluates at different times.

requirements.description: Evaluated at browse/listing time (no team context). Use for player-level rules such as keeperLevel, flags, or season. Drives the lock icon on mission rows. Null = always open.

launchRequirements.description: Evaluated at launch time with the actual selected team in context (teamSize, entity traits, entity stats). Both requirements AND launchRequirements must pass for startMission to succeed. Null = no additional team-level gating. Top-level rule labels are returned in launchRequirementStatus on GET /api/missions/definitions.

MissionDef_modal_fields.description: MissionDef modal hook fields. These are optional ModalDef references that attach custom narrative or informational modals to different stages of a mission's lifecycle.

leadInModalDefId.description: ModalDef.id for the narrative lead-in shown automatically when a player opens this mission for the first time each session. The player can reopen it at any time via the 'Open Narrative' button on the details page. The modal is resolved with context { mission } so templates can reference mission fields. Multi-page narratives use NEXT_PAGE / PREV_PAGE buttons.

activeModalDefId.description: ModalDef.id shown while the mission job is active.

readyModalDefId.description: ModalDef.id shown when the mission is ready to claim (falls back to activeModalDefId if unset).

completedModalDefId.description: ModalDef.id shown after the mission completes successfully.

failedModalDefId.description: ModalDef.id shown when the mission fails (falls back to completedModalDefId if unset).

QuestObjective.description: A single objective entry inside QuestDef.objectives. Applies to both quests and achievements (category='achievement' in QuestDef). Uses a unified RichSelection selector — including event-scope rules — to match telemetry events.

selector.description: RichSelection tree evaluated against a SelectionContext that includes the live telemetry event. Use event-scope rules to match on the event itself (event.type, event.key, event.amount, event.data.<path>) and any other scope (player, team, entity, context, etc.) for world-state filtering. All criteria live in this single block.

target.description: How many qualifying events are required to complete this objective.

label.description: Optional human-readable label shown in the UI for this objective.

ShopItemDef.description: A purchasable item in the player-facing store. Managed via the admin smart-editor at GET /api/admin/shopItemDef. Items outside their active date window are suppressed from the catalog automatically.

id.description: Unique identifier (e.g. gems_100). Auto-generated CUID when left blank.

name.description: Display name shown on the store card.

description.description: Short description shown on the card.

sectionId.description: Optional section within the tab (references ShopSectionDef.id). Items with no sectionId appear before sections.

cost.description: Array of ShopCostEntry objects. Supported types: 'currency' ({type, id, amount}), 'item' ({type, id, amount}), 'usd' ({type, amount, allowAda?}), 'ada' ({type, lovelaceAmount}), 'cnt' ({type, policyId, assetName, amount}).

originalCost.description: Original price shown with strikethrough. Same format as cost.

contents.description: Array of content entries granted to the player on purchase. Each entry has {type, id?, amount}. Supported types: 'currency' (id = currencyId, credits the player's balance), 'item' (id = itemDefinitionId, adds to inventory), 'outpost_slots' (no id — permanently increments the player's bonusOutpostSlots).

badge.description: Badge label shown on the card (e.g. HOT, NEW, SALE).

badgeColor.description: CSS color for the badge background.

imageUrl.description: URL or asset key for the card image.

displayOrder.description: Sort order within the tab/section. Lower = first.

enabled.description: Hidden from all players when false.

availableFrom.description: ISO datetime — item is suppressed from the catalog until this time. Null = available immediately. The admin list shows a 'scheduled' badge on not-yet-active rows.

limitedUntil.description: ISO datetime — item is automatically removed from the catalog after this time. When fewer than 24 h remain the player-facing card shows a live countdown. The admin list shows an 'expiring' badge on rows within 24 h of this deadline.

synergy-rules.json.description: Seed file for SynergyRule records. Loaded by definitions.seed.ts and upserted with upsertManyForce on every boot.

GameDefinition (seed-data.json).description: Seed records for GameDefinition table. type=screen_composition rows define UI composition for named screens. type=content_document rows define reusable ordered block lists for use by surfaces (screens, modals). All seed records have isActive=false (draft) and must be published via the admin publish endpoint.

ContentDocumentDefinition.description: A reusable, surface-agnostic block list stored in the GameDefinition table with type='content_document'. Blocks are ordered and rendered top-to-bottom by the surface that owns the document. The surface supplies runtime context (missionMode, teamMode, rewardMode); the document only declares structure.

id.description: Stable key matching the GameDefinition.key column (e.g. mission_planning_document).

version.description: Schema version for forward-compatibility. Increment when breaking changes are needed.

blocks.description: Ordered list of content blocks to render.

context.description: Optional default rendering context hints. Surfaces may override at render time.

Currency.description: A currency definition. Seeded via definitions.json and managed through the admin smart-editor.

symbol.description: Short symbol or emoji displayed next to balances (e.g. 🪙, DERP).

iconKey.description: Asset key used to resolve the currency icon image.

seasonId.description: Season this currency belongs to. null for non-seasonal currencies.

isTradeable.description: Whether this currency can be traded between players.

isSpendable.description: Whether players can spend this currency. When false, spend calls are rejected.

decimals.description: Number of decimal places for display and calculation.

enabled.description: When false, the currency is fully disabled across all active game systems.

showInTopBar.description: When true, this currency is shown in the player top bar. Toggle off to hide without fully disabling the currency.

sortOrder.description: Display order within the top bar. Lower numbers appear first (left-to-right). Ties broken alphabetically by id.

cntEcosystem.description: Blockchain ecosystem for CRYPTO currencies (e.g. 'CARDANO'). Null for non-crypto currencies.

cntWalletType.description: Wallet integration standard for CRYPTO currencies (e.g. 'CIP30'). Null for non-crypto currencies.

cntPolicyId.description: On-chain policy ID hex for CRYPTO currencies. Null for non-crypto currencies.

cntAssetName.description: On-chain asset name hex for CRYPTO currencies. Null for non-crypto currencies.

cntPriceAda.description: Admin-set ADA price per 1 CNT unit (e.g. 0.001). Used for ADA_VALUE / USD_VALUE minimum withdrawal checks. Set to 0 to disable value-based minimums.

cntMinWithdrawalType.description: Minimum withdrawal check mode: QUANTITY (plain unit count), ADA_VALUE (ADA equivalent), USD_VALUE (USD equivalent via live rate).

cntMinWithdrawalAmount.description: Minimum withdrawal amount interpreted per cntMinWithdrawalType.

cntWithdrawalFee.description: Flat withdrawal fee in CNT units deducted at withdrawal creation time.

cntAutoApprovalThreshold.description: Withdrawals at or below this CNT amount are auto-approved and processed immediately. 0 disables auto-approval.

ShopHeroDef.description: A hero banner card displayed in the store carousel above the tab bar. Banners cycle automatically every 5 seconds and support swipe navigation.

headline.description: Main banner headline displayed in uppercase with Cinzel font.

imageUrl.description: Background image URL or asset key. Displayed at 160px height.

backgroundColor.description: CSS background color used when no imageUrl is set or as an overlay base. Default: #1a1640.

ctaLabel.description: Call-to-action button label. Leave null to hide the button.

ctaTarget.description: CTA destination: a store tab ID (e.g. featured, gems) to switch tabs, or a full https:// URL to open externally.

sortOrder.description: Position in the carousel. Lower = left-most / first.

enabled.description: Disabled banners are hidden from all players.

limitedUntil.description: ISO datetime — banner automatically hides after this time.

ShopTabDef.description: A store tab that groups ShopItemDef rows in the player-facing store. Five canonical tabs are seeded automatically; additional tabs can be created by admins.

id.description: Unique tab identifier (e.g. featured, gems, currency). Used as the tab key on ShopItemDef rows.

name.description: Label shown in the player-facing tab strip. Supports emoji (e.g. 💎 Gems).

tabType.description: items = renders ShopItemDef rows. gems_packs = renders the special gem packs + Derp Pass UI.

layout.description: Card layout: featured = full-width cards, grid-3 = 3-column currency cards, grid-2 = 2-column item/bundle cards.

ungroupedPlacement.description: Where items with no sectionId appear relative to named sections. before = above all sections (default), after = below all sections.

sortOrder.description: Left-to-right tab order. Lower = further left.

enabled.description: Disabled tabs are hidden from all players.

ShopSectionDef.description: A named section header within a store tab. Items assigned to a section are rendered beneath the section heading. Ungrouped items (no sectionId) appear before any sections.

tabId.description: The ShopTabDef.id this section belongs to.

label.description: Section heading shown above the item group.

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle line shown below the heading.

sortOrder.description: Vertical ordering within the tab. Lower = higher on screen.

NftInitBlock.description: The `init.nft` block inside an EntityDefinition that is backed by an NftCollectionDef. Controls how raw on-chain NFT attributes are translated into game trait slots.

attributeMap.description: Maps raw NFT attribute key names (lowercased) to internal slot names. Multiple raw keys can map to the same slot. Example: { "meta_body": "body", "is leader": "leader" }

missingSlotPolicy.description: What to do when an NFT is missing an attribute for a declared slot. error: throw (blocks import). skip: silently omit the slot. default: use the value from `defaults` for that slot.

defaults.description: Fallback archetype values used when missingSlotPolicy=default. Keys are slot names; values are the archetype string to use. Example: { "leader": "none" }

slotTypes.description:
Optional per-slot type cast applied to the resolved archetype *before* it is stored in `entity.traits`. The archetype string is still used for traitDef lookup — only the persisted value is cast. Supported values:
- "string" (default, no-op)
- "boolean": "true", "yes", "1" → true; anything else → false
- "number": parsed via Number(); if NaN, falls back to string with a server warning
- "null": always stores null; skips stat processing but records the trait key

Example:
```json
{
  "is_leader": "boolean",
  "power_level": "number"
}
```

LootboxItemFields.description: Extra fields that apply when an ItemDefinition has type=LOOTBOX. A LOOTBOX item grants the player a chest/crate that can be opened via the OpenLootBox command. The item must reference a LootboxDef which defines the weighted outcome pool.

lootboxDefId.description: ID of the LootboxDef that defines the outcome pool. Required when type is LOOTBOX. Opening the item rolls against this pool using seeded RNG (seed = itemInstanceId + userId).

stackable.description: Lootbox items should be stackable (true). Set maxStack to control the per-stack limit (typically 99).

consumableData.description: Must be null for LOOTBOX items — opening is handled by the OpenLootBox command, not the consumable pipeline.

equipData.description: Must be null for LOOTBOX items.

DustingData.description: Dusting configuration for an ItemDefinition. When present, a 'Dust' action appears on the item in inventory. The player consumes the item and receives randomised rewards via the job/outcome-tier pipeline.

instant.description: If true, the job resolves in the same transaction with no timer. The command response includes instantRewards in meta.

timer.description: Standard Timer object controlling duration and skip behaviour. Ignored when instant=true. Fields: duration (seconds), boostable (bool), skipable (bool), skip_cost (array of {type,id,amount}), skip_type ('scaling'|'absolute').

timerScaling.description: flat: fixed duration regardless of quantity. per_unit: timer.duration * quantity.

difficulty.description: Pass/fail difficulty. 0 = always pass. Higher = harder. Uses rollPassFail(cl=0, difficulty).

tiers.description: Outcome tier blocks keyed by quality name. Supported keys: failure, common, uncommon, scare, rare, epic, mythic, legendary. Each block has { rewards: OutcomeEntry[], clRequirement?: number }.
